(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix action. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/coralogix-action-extension/.
applications  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Applies the action for specific applications.
created_by  tftypes.String computed
    description: The user who created the action.
description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Free-text description of the action. Removing this line clears the description.
dpxl_filter  tftypes.String computed
    description: DPXL expression that scopes when the action is offered. The expression must include a version prefix, e.g. `<v1> $d.severity == 'ERROR'`. Removing this line clears the filter.
id  tftypes.String required
    description: Action ID.
is_hidden  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Deprecated: `is_hidden` is a per-user UI preference, not a property of the action. It will be removed in a future version.
is_private  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Determines weather the action will be shared with the entire team. Can be set to false only by admin.
name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Action name.
source_type  tftypes.String computed
    description: By selecting the data type, you can make sure that the action will be displayed only in the relevant context. Can be one of ["DataMap" "Log"]
subsystems  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Applies the action for specific subsystems.
url  tftypes.String computed
    description: URL for the external tool.
url_fields  nested LIST computed
    description: Declarations for the `{{placeholder}}` slots in `url`, in the configured order.
url_fields.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: URL field name. Must be unique within `url_fields`.
url_fields.required  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Whether the field must be present for the action to be invokable.
